    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Download Locust Results

      - name: Download k6 Results

        run: |

          echo "" >> results/performance-report.md
          echo "## Test Summary" >> results/performance-report.md
          echo "" >> results/performance-report.md
          echo "- **Timestamp:** $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" >> results/performance-report.md
          echo "- **Virtual Users:** $TEST_VUS" >> results/performance-report.md
          echo "- **Duration:** $TEST_DURATION" >> results/performance-report.md

            echo '```' >> results/performance-report.md

            echo '```' >> results/performance-report.md

          path: results/performance-report.md

  notify:
    needs: performance-report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Notify Performance Failure
